project_info.theme: YSL The Slim lipstick shade spotlight in VR302
project_info.color_palette: Glittering deep red, mauve rose, white, black, gold

main_subject.detail: A macro beauty poster showing open lips wearing a muted mauve-rose matte lipstick shade, with black-polished fingers touching the mouth. The bottom copy reads 'THE SLIM VR 302' and 'HỒNG ĐẤT THỜI THƯỢNG'. A YSL The Slim lipstick bullet appears at lower right against a sparkling red glitter background.
main_subject.style: Sensual beauty macro advertising with editorial lip close-up and dramatic hand detail

composition_elements.text: YvesSaintLaurent BEAUTÉ; THE SLIM VR 302; HỒNG ĐẤT THỜI THƯỢNG
items: Top Left: YSL Beauté logo over the red glitter field
Top Right: Edge of the facial crop and black-polished fingernails entering the lip frame
Bottom Left: Large white shade-name typography
Bottom Right: YSL The Slim lipstick bullet with the mauve shade exposed
Center/Background: Square-framed macro photo of parted lips in a dusty mauve matte finish with fingers touching the lower lip

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft skin glow, matte lip texture detail, subtle shine on nails, glitter-speck backdrop

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square luxury beauty poster for YSL Beauté. Centerpiece is a macro close-up of parted lips wearing a dusty mauve matte lipstick, with black-polished fingers touching the mouth inside a square crop. Include the exact text 'THE SLIM VR 302' and 'HỒNG ĐẤT THỜI THƯỢNG', plus the YSL The Slim lipstick bullet at the lower right and the 'YvesSaintLaurent BEAUTÉ' logo above. Background is a glittering deep-red field. Technical style: photoreal beauty macro advertising composite, editorial glam close-up lighting, soft skin glow and matte lip texture detail, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Macro lips and fingers beauty reference
assets.usage: Preserve the lip shape, parted-mouth composition, and black manicure detail

assets.name: YSL The Slim lipstick in VR302
assets.usage: Match the casing and the muted rose-mauve shade of the bullet

assets.name: Deep red glitter backdrop
assets.usage: Maintain the festive red sparkle texture behind the square crop

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Keep the shot sensual and editorial. The glitter backdrop and the black manicure contrast are part of the exact style. Do not simplify it into a plain lipstick swatch card.
